item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meera's teacher in Jaipur explains how daytime length changes during the year. Which statement is not correct?

options.A: In India, the longest day of the year occurs around 21 June.
options.B: In India, the shortest day of the year occurs around 22 December.
options.C: Every place on Earth has the same day length changes during the seasons.
options.D: Near the Equator, day and night are each about 12 hours long throughout the year.
